name: draft-delta-stream
title: Stream draft output token-by-token via draft_delta events
description: Replace the atomic draft event with incremental draft_delta events forwarding the model's streamed structured-output JSON fragments (client concatenates and renders raw), plus the existing terminal draft/done events for the validated final result. Failure after deltas were emitted still commits failed and emits the single terminal error. Also update the frontend integration issue (knowledge-base-flutter#4) to the new contract. Note: gateway 60s whole-request deadline still applies and is a separate gateway-side task.
creator: lenny
